fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-06-19 (evening, 17:25): An online seller collected an advance of Rs. 58,000 for a product and then blocked the number of the complainant. A witness, Vasanth Mani, reachable on 9000000382, was mentioned in the complaint. The account reference SYN-ACC-100011 was noted in connection with the payment. The complainant alleged that Sathish Sundaram may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000372. The complaint refers to Udhay Muthu, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000352. Items referenced in the complaint: a bank transaction reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00099, as the mobile number 9000000372 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reportedly paid in advance and was blocked by the seller.
fields.Keywords: online shopping fraud, fake seller, suspect, mobile number, receiving account, college road, bank reference, witness
